title: Unbeatable Mode
description: If you think Minecraft is easy, this mod will fix that, as it makes the game far hard to beat than it would be in vanilla.
body:
This mod is the ultimate mechanics nightmare experince, as it adds in multiple features to make Minecraft a lot hard to defeat, and if you're feeling Minecraft is way too easy, this mod will fix that.

**List of features**

NPCs explode on death:  This applies to all NPC's in the game, whether they be villagers, hostile mobs, animals, and your own pets, when they die there will be an explosion where they used to be.

Buffs on damage: This applies to you as the player, and all other NPC's, upon taking damage every living entity in the game will gain strength, speed, invisibility, and fire resistance.

Destroying blocks gives you the wither effect: Pretty self explanatory, but you can no longer break blocks consequence free, as now you'll be inflicted with the wither debuff for 3 seconds after breaking a block.

Lightning strikes when blocking:  When you block now you won't just stop the enemy's attack, but also summon a bolt of lightning upon yourself, holding the block button does nothing, you need to block an actual attack.

Lightning strikes when crops grow:  Farming is an important part of Minecraft, or was, because now whenever a crop tries to grow, either in the wild, in a village, or as something you setup as the player, lightning will strike it destroying the crop.

Bonemeal places lava:  Bonemeal is not useful anymore, as it is dangerous, since when being used it'll place down a 3x3 pool of lava that will quickly spread.

Food jump boost: Don't eat before jumping in Minecraft, because now for a few seconds after eating you will have a massive jump boost that unless you land in water, will result in your characters death.

FAQ

Q: Can I use this in YT videos?
A: Absolutely, and if I see to many people beat it, I'll make the mod harder :)

Q: This mod is still to easy what should I do?
A  Let me know in the Discord server, and I'll add some other features to increase the difficulty.

Q: Is this a troll mod that makes the game actually impossible by punishing you for everything?
A: No, Minecraft might be beatable with this mod, but it does make the game a lot harder.
